title: Level 320 - "The new, and Improved, Entertainland!" (in-text: Level 320 - "Entertainland")
survival_class: not stated (header banner lists 'Safe', 'Sustained Economy', 'No Harmful Entities'; no class line)
physical_identity: Revived M.E.O.D.-run amusement park resort, formerly Level 32, about 200 m across in the four main directions, plus outside areas (Mountain, High Street/mall). Seasons follow the northern hemisphere; vegetation Earth-like.
scale_topology: Finite, outdoor/indoor mix. Car park + plaza with turnstiles -> Entertainland (7 zones) ; Mountain and High Street outside the park. Folding Point has 5 stories + basement. Non-Euclidean interiors/alley.
anomalies: Non-Euclidean shop interiors larger than their exteriors (Main Plaza, Folding Point, queues)
Dark Alley: straight alley lengthened with twists/intersections; 4th-dimensional overlap; recording shows pursuer set back several metres
Kiddie Zone deliberately has no Non-Euclidean effects
Rain scheduled only at closing time
Level 0/109/253 downscaled non-lethal recreations in Folding Point
lighting_sound: Day/night cycle with simulated summer sun (testimony); retro ambient speakers in Main Plaza; Folding Point mostly glass for natural light; Dark Alley gets gloomier and mist (TESTIMONY, recording). Sound otherwise not stated.

entities.name: Park staff (human, human adjacent or otherwise sentient; mascots, ride operators, guides, cleaners, night guards)
entities.behavior: Employed workers; mascots in outfits of existing IP characters and custom ones

entities.name: MVC
entities.behavior: Non-sentient beings living at the park to maintain plant ecosystems (no further description)

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: park staff/mascots and MVC maintenance beings; header banner says 'No Harmful Entities'; no hostile entity named in the current article
hazards: Rides in Kiddie Zone/others described as safe; no lethal hazards stated for the level
Dark Alley disorientation (Non-Euclidean separation) per recording
Pregnancy discouraged in Dark Alley (4th-dimensional overlap)
Prepaid ticket check; staff patrol deals with guests without valid passes
Variant tab 2067: ruined Folding Point crater reaching the Blue Channel; hail
items_communities: Prepaid cardboard/digital QR tickets; tiers (Holiday Homes needs specific tier)
Concessions, photos, souvenirs, meals, drying and tanning services paid separately
Three Holiday Homes hotels, about 50 rooms each
Camp venue in the Mountain (caravans); boating, rock climbing, parachuting
Level 118 has a separate 'Camp: Camp' (other level)

signature_mechanic: A bright, safe, ticketed theme-park resort reached via labelled brick archways; its identity is the seven themed zones with Non-Euclidean compact interiors (shops/queues bigger inside) and a Dark Alley that quietly loops pursuers. Not a survival level.
verticality: Folding Point: five stories plus basement (ride halls span floors 0-4); Mountain with trails; Piering In north on elevated wooden pier platform; Ferris wheel in testimony.

conflicts_notes: Tabbed page, 13 offsets. Offset 10 holds the current Level 320 article woven into an in-universe surveillance narrative; offset 0 is the older Level 32 'wayback' text; offsets 11-12 are later variants (2040 closure, 2067 ruin). Roster title 'The New and Improved Entertainland!' vs page title with comma. Offset-10 article says opening was 'a week ago on the 16th July'; recording dates 27/07/37.
